title: Ya-Sin 36:41-44 with words spaced, and the questions
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y10 lesson 25 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ya-Sin 36:41-44 with words spaced, and the questions)
intro: Lesson 25. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: وَءَايَةٌۭ لَّهُمْ أَنَّا حَمَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ (٤١) وَخَلَقْنَا لَهُم مِّن مِّثْلِهِۦ مَا يَرْكَبُونَ (٤٢)
وَإِن نَّشَأْ نُغْرِقْهُمْ فَلَا صَرِيخَ لَهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنقَذُونَ (٤٣) إِلَّا رَحْمَةًۭ مِّنَّا وَمَتَٰعًا إِلَىٰ حِينٍۢ (٤٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.

keywords.def: one who answers a cry for help

questions.q: Chunk and link Ya-Sin 36:41-44 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 36:41-44 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 36:41-44 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: What are 'the likes of it that they ride' (36:42)?
questions.a: Other means of carrying people, like other ships and vehicles; Allah gave people the means.

options: a mercy from Us and provision for a time
questions.a: A) a mercy from Us and provision for a time. 36:44: 'Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.'

questions.q: Ya-Sin 36:43: «وَإِن نَّشَأْ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Allah carried people in a laden ship and could drown them, 'except as a mercy from Us' (36:41 to 44). When did you last feel Allah's protection on a journey?
questions.a: Any journey that ended safely; we say the travel du'a and thank Allah.
